title: pedicularis resupinata var. typica
intro: Pedicularis resupinata var. typica, commonly known as Lophanthus resupinatus, is a plant species in the family Orobanchaceae. It is a type of flowering plant that is native to the mountainous regions of China. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pedicularis resupinata var. typica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to exert therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
